name: Kincsesbánya (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and black at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kincsesbánya: a black and red shield with a yellow eagle and crossed hammers, above a yellow scroll inscribed KINCSESBÁNYA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
